CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetHttpRequestData

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Returns a structure describing the HTTP request that is running the page, as the web server received it. Use it to read headers that have no CGI variable, or the raw body of a request that is not a form post, such as an XML or WDDX packet sent by another server with CFHTTP.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetHttpRequestData()

Returns

A structure with four keys:

Key Contents
Headers A structure with one entry per request header, for example Headers["User-Agent"].
Content The raw request body. A string when the Content-Type is text/... or application/x-www-form-urlencoded (or missing), otherwise a binary object. An empty string when there is no body.
Method The request method: GET, POST, HEAD, ...
Protocol The protocol and version from the request line, such as HTTP/1.0.

Usage

Form fields of a POST are still available in the Form scope; Content holds the same data in its encoded form. Header names are case-insensitive, like all structure keys.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Request_Data = GetHttpRequestData()>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>This page was requested with <B>#Request_Data.Method#</B> over #Request_Data.Protocol#.
The request body is #Len(Request_Data.Content)# bytes long.</P>
</CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR BGCOLOR="#CCCCCC"><TH>Header</TH><TH>Value</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP COLLECTION="#Request_Data.Headers#" ITEM="h">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#h#</TD><TD>#HTMLEditFormat(Request_Data.Headers[h])#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also

CFHTTP, CFHEADER, StructKeyList, IsBinary, ToString
